messages.subject: Error in cameraOperation
parts:
Hello Sir,
I am new to RStudio and I am trying to learn camtraR through your instructions. Currently I am working with my camera trap data. I encounter with a Error saying this ( Error in cameraOperation(CTtable = dat, stationCol = "Station", setupCol = "Date_set",  :  could not find column ProblemX_to). I am very confused where I am wrong. I will be very thankful to correct me

messages.author: 9c3183af58028473
messages.subject: Re: Error in cameraOperation
parts:
Thanks for providing lots of information to help understand your issue. Well done.  In your View listing, the last column is Problem_in.  R is looking for Problem_to. Try changing Problem_in to Problem_to where you first use Problem_in.

David

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in cameraOperation
parts:
Hi, 
please see 
data("camtraps") 
camtraps

for an example. In the error message you received, X stands for a number, e.g. "1" (or possibly higher numbers, but always starting with 1).
So you want columns that are called 
"Problem1_from" and  "Problem1_to" as in the example. If there were additional malfunction periods, the columns would be called "Problem2_from" and  "Problem2_to" etc.
Best,
Jürgen
